Since King's Day itself was swallowed by the launch chaos, Marta said we could do the belated orange-themed team lunch next Wednesday (June 24, 12:30, the Indonesian place around the corner). Two open points:

- vegetarian count: I have you, Jonas(?), and two others - can you confirm Jonas?
- the client demo that same afternoon needs the demo iPad. Someone has to carry it. You are demoing; I am ordering lunch. I propose the iPad is yours, unless you would rather trade jobs 😄

Danke!
Lena

messages.subject: Re: King's Day belated team lunch + demo iPad
messages.body:
Lena,

Quick recap:
1. Jonas is in for lunch (he confirmed in standup, grudgingly, which for Jonas is enthusiasm).
2. iPad: fine, I'll take it - I keep the cute orange case on it though, very on-theme. You're off the hook.
3. June 24, 12:30 confirmed from my side.

Thanks!
Priya

messages.subject: Re: King's Day belated team lunch + demo iPad
messages.body:
Hallo Priya,

All set then: lunch ordered for 12 with the vegetarian count at four, iPad officially yours (orange case included, very festive). I'll put both in the shared calendar now.

Danke!
Lena

messages.subject: Demo request - Rotterdam bike-courier startup
messages.body:
Dear Priya,

A small Rotterdam bike-courier startup (six riders, one very enthusiastic founder) has requested a product demo via the website form. I mention it to you first because the founder specifically asked whether the driver app handles "dutch bicycle chaos, meaning cobbles and rain", which I suspect is a product question rather than a finance one.

Could you or someone from your team take the demo, or shall I hand it to sales? No urgency expressed by them, but enthusiasm of that kind tends not to wait long.

Kind regards,
Helen Oyelaran
Chief Financial Officer, Parcelwise B.V.

messages.subject: LogiConnect Europe 2026 - partner sessions announced (incl. Ledgerly onboarding)
messages.body:
Hello there,

The partner programme for LogiConnect Europe 2026 (Utrecht, 22-23 April) is now live. Highlights:

- "Migrating payment providers without downtime" - a hands-on onboarding session run by our Gold partner Ledgerly (limited seats)
- "EU data residency for delivery platforms" - panel
- The courier meetup, back by popular demand

Early-bird attendee pricing ends 28 February. Want your team featured? Reply and we'll send the partner brochure.

See you in Utrecht!
The LogiConnect Europe Team

messages.subject: Scheduling our call - one constraint
messages.body:
Aisha,

Following up on the collections call you mentioned. Before we fix a slot: I see on the shared logistics calendar that Harbor Express has a collections call on Wednesday February 4 at 10:00. Please schedule ours well clear of that one - I dislike overlapping with anything touching overdue accounts, it makes for distracted participants.

Proposals from my side: Tuesday February 3 at 15:00, or Thursday February 5 at 11:00. I will need the agenda 24 hours in advance, as usual, and please use the video link with the waiting room enabled.

Regards,
Carla Dunne
Head of Operations, Swiftbox

messages.subject: Office account login loop - sorry to bother
messages.body:
Hi Lena,

Sorry to bother you - the shared office admin account seems stuck in a login loop after I reset its password this morning. I type the new password, it accepts it, then bounces me straight back to the login screen. I tried the other browser and clearing cookies, no luck.

It might be something I did wrong during the reset, sorry if so. Could you tell me who normally handles this, or is it a support ticket thing? I don't want to make it worse by poking at it.

Thanks,
Ravi

messages.subject: Re: Office account login loop - sorry to bother
messages.body:
Hallo Ravi,

Nothing to apologise for - good instinct to stop poking.

- I filed this with support at 10:40 already (ticket #8841-ish, they renumbered it twice, sorry).
- Known issue after resets, their workaround is the Chrome profile on the front-desk PC.
- You did nothing wrong: I watched Helen reset it Monday and it looped for her too.

Danke!
Lena
